eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CIVIL EMERGENCY MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Juneau, AK; at 5:48 PM on AUG 11, 2026 Effective until 5:48 AM AUG 12, 2026. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: City and Borough of Juneau: Suicide Basin is releasing. Flooding is expected late Wednesday thru early Thursday. If you are in a flood zone, evacuation is advised. Stay clear of rivers. An emergency evacuation shelter will be open at Floyd Dryden Gym. Another alert will be issued if conditions change. Visit https://juneau.org/ for updates and safety info.
